title: Sum of Beauty of All Substrings
summary: Calculate the beauty of each substring by finding the difference between the most and least frequent characters, then sum these values for all substrings of the given string.
statement: Calculate the beauty of each substring by finding the difference between the most and least frequent characters, then sum these values for all substrings of the given string.
constraints: The beauty of a substring is its highest positive character frequency minus its lowest positive character frequency.
Return the sum of beauty over every substring.
hints: Fixing a left endpoint lets one frequency table serve every expanding right endpoint.
For each left index, extend right while updating one character count and adding current max minus min.
Take min only across present dictionary values, not absent alphabet letters.
Every substring appears once for its endpoint pair, and its maintained counts exactly define its beauty.
editorial: Every substring appears once for its endpoint pair, and its maintained counts exactly define its beauty.

tests.explanation: The nonzero beauties across all substrings sum to five.
Accumulating max-minus-min frequencies for every start and end gives seventeen.
